front_pt: Fale um pouco sobre você.
front_en: Tell me about yourself.
back: I'm a software developer with experience in Java and backend development. I enjoy solving problems and learning new technologies.

front_pt: Por que você quer trabalhar aqui?
front_en: Why do you want to work here?
back: I'm interested in this position because I believe my skills match the role, and I'd like to grow professionally with the company.

front_pt: Quais são seus pontos fortes?
front_en: What are your strengths?
back: I'm organized, responsible, and I'm always willing to learn. I'm also good at solving problems.

front_pt: Quais são seus pontos fracos?
front_en: What are your weaknesses?
back: Sometimes I focus too much on details, but I've been learning how to manage my time better.

front_pt: Por que devemos contratar você?
front_en: Why should we hire you?
back: Because I'm motivated, I learn quickly, and I'm committed to delivering good results.

front_pt: Por que você deixou seu último emprego?
front_en: Why did you leave your last job?
back: I was looking for a new challenge and an opportunity to grow professionally.

front_pt: Onde você se vê daqui a cinco anos?
front_en: Where do you see yourself in five years?
back: I see myself in a more senior position, taking on greater responsibilities and continuing to develop my skills.

front_pt: Como você trabalha em equipe?
front_en: How do you work in a team?
back: I communicate clearly, listen to other people, and try to contribute to the team's goals.

front_pt: Conte sobre um problema que você resolveu.
front_en: Tell me about a problem you solved.
back: I had a difficult technical problem, so I analyzed the situation, researched possible solutions, and worked with my team to fix it.

front_pt: Qual é sua expectativa salarial?
front_en: What are your salary expectations?
back: I'm open to discussing the compensation based on the responsibilities of the position and the overall benefits package.

front_pt: Você está disposto a trabalhar remotamente?
front_en: Are you comfortable working remotely?
back: Yes. I'm comfortable working remotely and I'm used to communicating with teammates online.

front_pt: Você tem experiência trabalhando com equipes internacionais?
front_en: Do you have experience working with international teams?
back: I'm comfortable communicating in English and I'm interested in working with people from different countries and cultures.

front_pt: Você tem alguma pergunta para nós?
front_en: Do you have any questions for us?
back: Yes. Could you tell me more about the team and what a typical day in this position looks like?

front_pt: Conte-me sobre uma ocasião em que você cometeu um erro.
front_en: Tell me about a time you made a mistake.
back: I once made a mistake because I didn't check all the requirements carefully. I learned from it and became more careful about reviewing my work.

front_pt: Descreva uma decisão difícil que você teve que tomar.
front_en: Describe a difficult decision you had to make.
back: I had to choose between two possible solutions for a project. I analyzed the advantages and disadvantages and chose the option that was more reliable and easier to maintain.

front_pt: Conte-me sobre um conflito com um colega de trabalho.
front_en: Tell me about a conflict with a coworker.
back: We had different opinions about how to solve a problem. We discussed the situation calmly, listened to each other, and agreed on the best solution for the project.

front_pt: Conte-me sobre um projeto que fracassou e o que você aprendeu com ele.
front_en: Tell me about a project that failed and what you learned from it.
back: A project I worked on did not achieve all its goals because we underestimated the complexity. I learned the importance of planning, communication, and identifying risks early.

front_pt: Como você reage quando recebe uma tarefa que não sabe fazer?
front_en: How do you react when you are given a task you don't know how to do?
back: I first try to understand the problem, research the topic, and ask questions when necessary. I see it as an opportunity to learn something new.

front_pt: Como você lida com mudanças de última hora?
front_en: How do you handle last-minute changes?
back: I try to stay flexible, understand the reason for the change, and adjust my priorities to meet the new requirements.

front_pt: Conte-me sobre uma vez em que você trabalhou sob um prazo apertado.
front_en: Tell me about a time you worked under a tight deadline.
back: We had a short deadline for a project, so I focused on the most important requirements, communicated with my team, and worked efficiently to deliver the project on time.

front_pt: Como você recebe feedback do seu gerente?
front_en: How do you respond to feedback from your manager?
back: I listen carefully and try to understand what I can improve. I appreciate constructive feedback because it helps me grow professionally.

front_pt: Como você define um trabalho bem-sucedido?
front_en: How do you define successful work?
back: I consider work successful when the goals are achieved, the quality is good, and the solution provides value to the team or the company.

front_pt: Quais tecnologias você conhece?
front_en: What technologies are you familiar with?
back: I have experience with Java, SQL, databases, and Oracle APEX. I’m also interested in learning new technologies.

front_pt: Qual habilidade você gostaria de desenvolver?
front_en: What skill would you like to develop?
back: I would like to improve my technical knowledge and communication skills so I can contribute more effectively to projects.

front_pt: Você prefere trabalhar presencialmente ou remotamente?
front_en: Do you prefer working on-site or remotely?
back: I’m comfortable with both options. I can adapt to the company’s needs and communicate effectively in either environment.

front_pt: Por que você escolheu trabalhar com tecnologia?
front_en: Why did you choose to work in technology?
back: I chose technology because I enjoy solving problems, learning new things, and creating useful solutions.

front_pt: Quando você pode começar a trabalhar?
front_en: When can you start working?
back: I’m available to start according to the company’s needs, and I’m open to discussing the best starting date.
